title: Decoding universal cycles for t-subsets and t-multisets by decoding bounded-weight de Bruijn sequences
summary: A universal cycle for a set S of combinatorial objects is a cyclic sequence of length |S| that contains a representative of each element in S exactly once as a substring. Despite the many universal cycle constructions known in the literature for various sets including k-ary strings of length n, permutations of order n, t-subsets of an n-set, and t-multisets of an n-set, remarkably few have efficient decoding (ranking/unranking) algorithms.
